ideas.title: Cyberattacks on Water Systems: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cyberattacks on water systems in the United States and the potential impact on public health and safety.
questions: What are the potential consequences of a cyberattack on a water system?
How are authorities responding to the threat?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant threat to public health and safety. I recommend investigating the financial motivations behind the attacks and the response of authorities.
